What is the value of average foreign trade by country P in all 5 years?
solution:
**Formula:**

The average (arithmetic mean) of a set of values can be calculated by summing all the values and dividing the sum by the total number of values.

Average = (Sum of all values)/(Total number of values)

**Solution:**

Sum of values in the "P" column = 220 + 200 + 125 + 115 + 85 = 745

Average foreign trade by country P = Sum of values / Total number of years

= 745 / 5

= 149

**Therefore, the average foreign trade by country P in all 5 years is 149.**
